business_summary: SV Vision Limited, an investment holding company, provides marketing production and content media services in Hong Kong and the People's Republic in China, and internationally. The company offers brand identity and asset development, and design and art direction for various media formats; and UX/UI design, development and implementation, eDM and e-newsletter solutions, ecommerce solutions, digital brand asset production, and WhatsApp-based marketing solutions. It also provides brand stories, corporate videos and interviews, animation and infographics, and volume video adaptation and transcreation, as well as photography services comprising key visuals, product shots, and photo-retouch; and print and packaging design and engineering, gifts and promotional items, confidential data printing, and direct mailing services. In addition, the company creates and designs materials and content for visual merchandising, retail merchandising and venue decoration, and designs and produces window displays, signs, interior displays, and special promotional displays. Further, it provides post planning, scheduling, and production; campaign creative development and implementation; social media advertising planning and implementation; content distribution and reporting; and influencer marketing services. Additionally, the company is involved in the provision of brand management and print consulting services; and creation, production, licensing original film and TV content, format and intellectual property rights. The company was formerly known as Icicle Group Holdings Limited and changed its name to SV Vision Limited in August 2022. SV Vision Limited was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Chai Wan, Hong Kong.
